description.value: Westholme Tea Company is a working organic tea farm and artisanal teashop in the Cowichan Valley near Chemainus, one of only a handful of places in Canada growing true Camellia sinensis tea plants. The farm imports and hand-blends organic loose-leaf teas from estates around the world alongside their own rare Canadian-terroir harvest. Cyclists touring the Cowichan Valley have specifically noted stopping in here for tea samples and welcoming service from staff.
